description: This is the configuration file for the Intune Helpdesk script. It contains the settings for the script to run correctly.

requiredScopes.Reason: Required to read user profiles, group memberships, and registered devices.
Required to read Microsoft Entra ID device objects.
Required to read application information and manage app assignments.
Required to read Intune device configuration policies.
Required to read Intune managed device properties.
Required for highly privileged operations, specifically to read local admin (LAPS) passwords.
Required to read Autopilot events and to read and manage Autopilot device identities.
Required to read BitLocker recovery keys for all devices.
Standard scope required for user sign-in with OpenID Connect.
Standard scope to get basic user profile information during sign-in.

requiredScopes.reason: Required to create, update, and delete Intune device configuration policies.
Required to read application information in Intune.
Required to create, update, and delete Intune managed device properties.
Required for privileged operations on managed devices, such as reading LAPS passwords.
Required to read BitLocker recovery keys for all devices.
Standard scope required for user sign-in with OpenID Connect.
Standard scope to get basic user profile information during sign-in.
Standard scope that provides refresh tokens to maintain access when the user is not active.
